name: Grokart
description: Searches Shopify stores for the item you describe, puts a short shortlist in front of you, then hands over a merchant payment link to finish the purchase. Useful when you know roughly what you want but not where to buy it; the checkout itself stays with the shop.

official.title: Grokart by Luiz
official.description: Find what you want across the Shopify catalog, then check out. It searches, shows a few options, and sends a merchant pay link.
